reviews.title: Fight for your brain
reviews.text:
The internet is making us all stupid. You don’t have the attention span you used to. This app will help you fight back. I use it to keep me from getting on my phone first thing in the morning, and to have 45-min sessions where I’m amazed at how much I can focus and how much I can get done. It’s easy to use and customizable. 

Rage against the dying of the light!

reviews.title: Freedom revoked
reviews.text: Sadly, when a glitch caused the app to malfunction, technical support volunteered an easy way to turn off the VPN powering the app, rendering the entire thing useless to my browsing-addicted brain. The entire point of the app is to make it difficult to turn off. By volunteering the override process to someone who never wanted to know it, you actually took away the freedom I was enjoying for several months. I’m very disappointed and am now back to square one in battling my addiction.
